subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Apreciar poemas e outros textos versificados, observando rimas, sonoridades, jogos de palavras, reconhecendo seu pertencimento ao mundo imaginário e sua dimensão de encantamento, jogo e fruição.

components.description_pt: Identificar rimas, padrões sonoros e jogos de palavras em poemas e textos versificados
components.description_en: Identify rhymes, sound patterns, and wordplay in poems and versified texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify structural elements of poems such as verse, rhythm, and meter

components.description_pt: Reconhecer poemas e textos versificados como pertencentes ao campo da imaginação e fruição estética
components.description_en: Recognize poems and versified texts as belonging to the realm of imagination and aesthetic enjoyment
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between storybooks and poems based on their features

components.description_pt: Apreciar as dimensões lúdicas e encantadoras de poemas e textos versificados
components.description_en: Appreciate the playful and enchanting dimensions of poems and versified texts
components.cc_component_description: Identify words and phrases in poems that appeal to the senses

cc_matches.description: Recognize common types of texts (e.g., storybooks, poems).
Identify words and phrases in stories or poems that suggest feelings or appeal to the senses.

Explain major differences between poems, drama, and prose, and refer to the structural elements of poems (e.g., verse, rhythm, meter) and drama (e.g., casts of characters, settings, descriptions, dialogue, stage directions) when writing or speaking about a text.
